item.title: Malaysia Doesn’t Need Your EPF Savings To Fix Hospital Bills — Dr Pearl Leong
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
Allowing Malaysians to use EPF to buy medical insurance means that we're using our retirement savings to keep funding large hospital bills in private hospitals. GLCs and GLICs that own major hospital groups should control hospital charges instead.
